en_title: Konami Planning 'Second and Third Waves' of New Silent Hill Games
cn_title: 科乐美正筹划《寂静岭》后两波新作
subtitle: 不止于第一波
opus_summary: 制作人冈本基表示，科乐美正考虑《寂静岭》第二、第三波新作，目前在评估多个项目，尚不能透露细节。首波公布的三款游戏均已顺利发售并获得好评，科乐美对此感到满意。

paragraphs.en: Konami is planning "second and third waves" of new Silent Hill games, according to producer Motoi Okamoto.
paragraphs.cn: 据制作人冈本基透露，科乐美正筹划「第二、第三波」《寂静岭》新作。

paragraphs.en: Okamoto offered a foggy glimpse into the classic horror franchise's future during an interview featured in Famitsu Issue 1965 (via Game Observer ). The series ended a long, painful drought without new games with an initial wave of new releases over the last few years, and now that this first batch is out, Konami is already looking forward to what it can do next.
paragraphs.cn: 冈本基在《Fami通》第1965期刊登的采访中，隐约透露了这个经典恐怖系列的未来方向（消息经Game Observer转述）。过去几年，系列陆续推出了第一波新作，结束了漫长而煎熬的新作空窗期。如今首批作品均已发售，科乐美已经开始展望接下来还能做些什么。

paragraphs.en: "All three titles we initially announced were able to be released successfully, so we’re relieved (laughs)," he noted. "They’ve also received high praise, and we are satisfied with it."
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「最初公布的三款作品都顺利发售了，所以我们松了一口气（笑）。这几款作品也获得了很高的评价，我们对此感到满意。」

paragraphs.en: Okamoto continued: "Successfully launching this 'first wave' comes with great relief, but we’re not stopping here; we must think of the second and third waves. We can’t share specific details, but we’re currently looking at a number of projects."
paragraphs.cn: 冈本基接着说：「第一波作品顺利推出，让我们大大松了一口气，但我们不会就此止步；我们必须考虑第二、第三波作品。具体细节还不能透露，不过我们目前正在考察多个项目。」

paragraphs.en: The first wave of Konami's return to Silent Hill – which included titles like the Silent Hill 2 remake , Silent Hill f , and last month's Silent Hill: Townfall – rolled out throughout the last few years. Townfall arrived as the most recent installment when it dropped players into the shoes of protagonist Simon Ordell in a '90s Scotland just last month.
paragraphs.cn: 科乐美重启《寂静岭》系列后的第一波作品在过去几年陆续推出，其中包括《寂静岭2》重制版、《寂静岭f》，以及上个月发售的《Silent Hill: Townfall》。《Silent Hill: Townfall》是系列最新作，刚于上个月带领玩家来到20世纪90年代的苏格兰，扮演主角Simon Ordell。

paragraphs.en: It received generally favorable reviews, with IGN giving it an 8/10 . We said, "Like the intravenous needle permanently jutting out of its hero’s wrist, Silent Hill: Townfall gives this long running series a welcome shot in the arm."
paragraphs.cn: 本作总体获得好评，IGN给出了8分的评价，满分10分。我们在评测中写道：「就像主角手腕上始终插着的静脉注射针一样，《Silent Hill: Townfall》为这个历史悠久的系列注入了一剂令人欣喜的强心针。」

paragraphs.en: It's a successful run of games that Konami is happy with, but getting here wasn't easy. After Hideo Kojima's Silent Hills failed to materialize, Okamoto said he had a hard time convincing higher-ups that more games was the way to go. However, as far as he was concerned, "just one remake is not enough," adding, "as a producer, I cannot let it end only with that."
paragraphs.cn: 这几款游戏接连取得成功，让科乐美感到满意，但走到这一步并不容易。冈本基表示，小岛秀夫的《Silent Hills》未能问世后，他费了很大力气才说服高层，让他们相信应该继续推出更多游戏。不过，在他看来，「仅有一款重制版还不够」。他补充道：「作为制作人，我不能让这个系列仅仅止步于此。」

paragraphs.en: "If there were only one release, wouldn’t people think that the development is going to be cancelled again, I thought," Okamoto added.
paragraphs.cn: 冈本基补充道：「我当时想，如果只推出一款作品，大家难道不会觉得后续开发又要被取消了吗？」

paragraphs.en: While Konami's plan to launch additional waves of Silent Hill games spells a promising future for fans who have missed the franchise, we have known that the series would continue in some form. Bloober Team, the horror-centric developer responsible for the Silent Hill 2 remake, confirmed it was working on a remake of the original Silent Hill last year.
paragraphs.cn: 科乐美计划再推出几波《寂静岭》游戏，让思念这个系列的粉丝看到了值得期待的未来。不过，我们此前就已知道，系列会以某种形式延续下去。负责《寂静岭2》重制版、专注恐怖游戏的开发商Bloober Team去年已确认，正在开发初代《寂静岭》的重制版。
